p.i: cedi debet & est verissimum, Non satisfecisse officio qui se ingessit, ni fecerit quod debuit: satisfecisse qui admonitus est, si fecerit quod potuit.

Exposui pluribus, Auditores, provinciam hanc quo concilio jam olim suscepe-rim:cur in ea administranda toto quadriennio nil gestum fit, si forte requiratis, paucioribus expediam. Quo tempore reverendus in Christo Pater Vigorniæ Episcopus, cathedrâ pastorali conscenså, doctoralem hanc quam permultis jam annis plurimùm ornaverat, mihi successori designato reliquit (fuit id æstivâ vacatione circiter Kal. Sextiles:) discessi tum hinc ea mente, ut proximo termino Michaelis certo etiam die constituto, Kal. &c.[?] Novembribus reverterer; res domesticas interea componerem, eáque.

page.notes: Catchword "curarem" is the first word of the next page and is kept out of the text. Line-end hyphens are joined: "sa-tisfecisse", "pro-vinciam", "to-to", "Michae-lis", "do-mesticas". "Quo" is underlined in the print; underline is not italic, so no tag is used. "Kal. &c." is read from "sc." and marked [?]. The first word "cedi" is a fragment from the previous page and stays as printed. Long s is written as plain s throughout. Faint marks at the bottom left are stains or a signature, not transcribed.
